chassis.description: The chassis: page ground, html background and scrollbar track.

field.description: Wells set below the ground: inputs, the key well, the network badge, the Lace note.

housing.description: The instrument housing fill behind the tubes.

plate.description: The fill of every drawn plate: switch panel, desk plates, credential, case plates.

mesh.description: Hairlines: top-plate rule, engraved-heading rules, table header rule, field and notice borders.

rule-faint.description: The fainter divider between table rows and member rows.

steel.description: Ring terminals, nav connectors, tag and quiet-button borders, list markers, link underlines.

glass.description: Display headlines, the wordmark, engraved headings and channel labels: steel-grey caps.

ink-2.description: Secondary prose, field labels, nav at rest, status words at rest.

ink-3.description: Tertiary text: footer, provenance, table heads, placeholders, the Closed status.

plasma.description: Live only: the lit switch, focus outline, caret, selection, current nav item, Waiting lamp.

plasma-soft.description: Lit tube numerals, the live clock and every value read from the ledger.

on-plasma.description: Text on a plasma fill (selection, skip link).

ontime.description: The On time lamp and word, the connected dot, a registered credential, the done face.

on-ontime.description: Text on the filled green done face.

late.description: Delayed lamp, late and overdue text, errors, danger button, alarm and confirmation boxes.

on-late.description: Text on the filled red danger button.

display.purpose: The counter's headline, uppercase, Engraved Glass, max 14ch; 38px at phone width.

headline.purpose: The uppercase h1 of the working screens (Report, Officer desk).

title.purpose: Uppercase heading inside a plate, in Warm Ink; 21px at phone width.

lede.purpose: The plain sentence-case sub-line under a display headline, max 46ch.

body.purpose: All running text, tabular figures, lines held to 60 to 66ch.

body-sm.purpose: Hints, errors, notes, status lines, the footer.

label.purpose: Uppercase engraved section headings and work sub-heads in Engraved Glass.

label-control.purpose: Uppercase label of the lit switch and primary buttons.

label-control-sm.purpose: Uppercase label of quiet, subtle and danger buttons.

label-field.purpose: Uppercase label above every field, in Worn Ink.

label-status.purpose: Uppercase word beside each status lamp; thread speaker names.

label-plate.purpose: Uppercase channel names under the tubes and table column heads.

label-tag.purpose: Uppercase Planned and Demo organisation tags.

numeral.purpose: Nixie numerals inside tubes only; never words.

clock.purpose: The live clock in the top plate, amber with glow; 17px at phone width.

mono.purpose: Case ids, member fingerprints and the contract address, inline at 0.86em.

mono-field.purpose: Member keys in the key well and mono inputs for keys and key files.

shadows.name: plate-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts every drawn plate off the chassis; a filter so it follows the frame.

shadows.name: switch-recess
shadows.purpose: Switches at rest, sunk into the plate.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Focused field: well plus a 1px plasma ring.

shadows.name: name-plate-inset
shadows.purpose: Recessed channel name plates under the tubes.

shadows.name: top-plate-seam
shadows.purpose: Black seam under the top plate's mesh rule.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one curve (ease-out-expo), token --ease; every transition and the fade-in use it.

motion.name: tube-cross-fade
motion.purpose: Signature move: the old numeral dims as the new one lights when a value changes, including the first read. Single cross-fade, no flicker.

motion.name: switch-state
motion.purpose: Switch and button hover; active presses down 1px (translateY(1px)).

motion.name: done-flip
motion.value: fade-in 420ms (ease) both: opacity 0 to 1, blur(2px) to blur(0)
motion.purpose: A quick action flips to its done face for 2 seconds.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.purpose: Chevron turn on an open disclosure.

motion.name: spinner
motion.purpose: Busy ring in a button during a long operation.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition off; values swap instantly.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Top plate wraps, instrument compacts, case table becomes cards, counter page reorders.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width (not a media query).

assets.role: Gunmetal plate frame, 9-slice border-image (slice 18, 14px border), two top-corner screws.
Instrument housing frame, 9-slice border-image (slice 20, 16px border), deep bevel, four corner screws.
Empty IN-14 style nixie envelope (100 x 190); numerals are live text over it.
Slotted screw head, 10px, at both ends of every switch.
Six inline SVG icons, 18px, 2px stroke, currentColor.
Self-hosted Big Shoulders Display, Saira Semi Condensed, Saira, Nixie One, JetBrains Mono.

narrative.overview:
Sotto is set as a bench instrument, not a page. The channel's record is read off a counter: every count and countdown is a lit numeral inside a drawn glass tube, the tubes stand in a blackened-steel housing, and each channel is named on a small recessed plate in engraved steel caps. The ground is a warm near-black steel chassis. Gunmetal plates, fastened with screws, lift off it and hold the units people act on; switches and fields sink into those plates. The record reads as a measurement nobody typed.

There is one light source. Plasma orange is the only colour that glows, and it lights only what is live: lit numerals, values read from the ledger, the clock, the waiting lamp, the current position, focus, and the switch that acts. Everything else is steel and warm ink. Two lamp colours, green and red, report state, and each lamp always stands beside its word. Density is instrument-like and calm: condensed caps carry the hierarchy, a rounded technical sans carries the reading at 17px in sentence case, and tabular numerals keep every count aligned.

The user built and rejected two earlier looks: the editorial paper look (warm paper, serif, ink) and the station departure board (deep blue ground, signal yellow). The category's white-and-navy dashboard of stat cards is what this world refuses. Condensed caps are native here; what was rejected about the departure board is its blue-and-yellow signage, not condensed type.
keyCharacteristics: A blackened, slightly warm steel chassis with gunmetal plates and an instrument housing drawn as 9-slice SVG frames with screws.
Live counts as lit Nixie numerals in drawn IN-14 tube envelopes, all ten unlit numerals faintly visible behind the lit one.
Plasma orange as the only glow, reserved for what is live.
Steel-grey condensed engraved caps for every heading, label and button; sentence-case Saira for prose.
Status lamps that always carry their word.
One signature move: a tube cross-fades from the old numeral to the new one, including the first read; reduced motion swaps instantly.

rules.name: The Live Light Rule
rules.body: Plasma is light, and light means live. It appears only on lit numerals, ledger values, the clock, the Waiting lamp, the current position, focus, caret, selection and the action switch. It never fills a surface (selection and the skip link are the only plasma fills), never sets running text, and never decorates.

rules.name: The Lamp And Word Rule
rules.body: State is never colour alone. Every lamp sits beside its word (On time, Waiting, Delayed, Closed), a late channel's count says how many, and the network dot is followed by the word "reconnecting" when it turns red.

rules.name: The No Neon Rule
rules.body: No blues and no purples anywhere. The only saturated hues are plasma orange, lamp green and alarm red.

rules.name: The Engraved Caps Rule
rules.body: Every heading, label, button and tag is uppercase condensed caps with open tracking (0.05em at display sizes, 0.1em to 0.2em on labels). Running text, hints, errors, inline links and disclosure rows stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Glass Numeral Rule
rules.body: Nixie One sets the numerals inside tubes and the live clock, nothing else. Words never go in the tube face.

rules.name: The Ledger Mono Rule
rules.body: Anything copied from or checkable against the ledger (case ids, member keys, fingerprints, the contract address, elapsed proving time) is set in JetBrains Mono, usually in Lit Numeral Amber.

rules.name: The Lifted Plate, Sunken Control Rule
rules.body: Plates and the housing rise off the chassis; switches, fields and name plates sink into what holds them. Nothing else takes an outer shadow.

rules.name: The Only Light Glows Rule
rules.body: A coloured glow belongs to lit numerals, the clock, lit lamps, the wordmark's tube and the hovered switch. A static surface never glows.

rules.name: The Plates Frame Units Rule
rules.body: A drawn, screwed plate frames each unit someone acts on: the File a report panel, the desk plates, the credential, each case. The case log, the readouts and member lists sit unframed on the chassis, ruled by hairlines.

dos: Do put every live count in tubes: lit Nixie numerals in the drawn envelope, the unlit stack faintly visible, a single 520ms cross-fade when a value changes.
Do reserve plasma (#ff8a00, #ffb35c) for what is live: numerals, ledger values, the clock, the Waiting lamp, the current position, focus, caret, selection and the action switch.
Do pair every lamp with its word, and give every tube channel a full spoken sentence for screen readers.
Do set headings, labels, buttons and tags in uppercase condensed caps with 0.1em to 0.2em tracking, and all running text in sentence-case Saira at 15 to 17px.
Do set ledger values (case ids, keys, fingerprints, the contract address) in JetBrains Mono.
Do frame each unit someone acts on with the drawn plate or housing (9-slice SVG with screws), and sink controls into it with inset shadows.
Do keep touch targets at 44px minimum (52px for switches) and the 2px plasma focus outline at a 3px offset.
Do honour reduced motion: every animation and transition off, values swap instantly.
Do mark anything not yet built with the Planned tag and the demo organisation with the Demo organisation tag.
donts: Don't use the editorial paper look (warm paper, serif, ink) or the station departure board (deep blue ground, signal yellow); the user built and rejected both.
Don't build the category's white-and-navy dashboard of stat cards; counts live in the instrument, not in cards.
Don't use neon blues or purples, or any saturated hue beyond plasma orange, lamp green and alarm red.
Don't make anything glow that is not lit; static surfaces take no coloured shadow.
Don't convey state by colour alone.
Don't set words in Nixie One, or running text in uppercase caps.
Don't ship an irreversible action without a confirmation box.
